{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check premises
premise_1 = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum() == 6
premise_2 = df['revenue'].dtype == 'object'  # string type
premise_3 = set(df['status'].unique()) == {'completed', 'refunded'}

# Print findings
print(f"Premise 1 (6 test orders): {premise_1}")
print(f"Premise 2 (revenue is string): {premise_2}")
print(f"Premise 3 (status has only two values): {premise_3}")

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
sentinel_count = (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {sentinel_count}")"}
